svg.aria-label: Illustrated overview of Setu, drawn as a bridge. On the left a customer writes or speaks in their own language on a phone. The message crosses the bridge: the Flask server saves it, a background AI worker asks Google Gemini through a PII shield and one time-boxed, metered model client, and the decision engine either lets the assistant reply or hands high and critical cases, cancellations and billing disputes to an agent on the right. A write the model proposes on an agent's turn waits for an admin, and only an approved action changes orders.json. Cases live in SQLite beneath the bridge.
